prior_2026_quantum_capacity.interpretation: Capacities are conditional on a hypothetical P-CTC channel; not a physical backwards message demonstrated.

mapping_from_book_and_physics.implementation: born_rule(logits) forms nonnegative real amplitudes via exp(half log softmax) and squares; same numerical predictive distribution as standard softmax
mapping_from_book_and_physics.correctness_test: Sum probabilities=1; no nonfinite entries; invariant under logit shifts
mapping_from_book_and_physics.limitation: Equivalent reparameterization; no quantum computing speedup or entanglement.
Invertible numerical operation is not reversal of elapsed time.

mapping_from_book_and_physics.implementation: Frozen exact source SHA, unchanged 196-event chronology holdout, independent V1 checkpoint, failure-recording even when metrics worsen
mapping_from_book_and_physics.limitation: No physical retrocausal claim derived from ML accuracy.

mapping_from_book_and_physics.implementation: Balance rare class labels ONLY from training data, select temperature and model blend on validation, compare with V1 and training-only frequency baseline
mapping_from_book_and_physics.limitation: Model selection on a short serially correlated test cannot establish universal predictive improvement.

mapping_from_book_and_physics.implementation: Past-only noise augmentations and KL consistency objective; independent future RNG prediction remains a separate precommitted experiment
mapping_from_book_and_physics.limitation: KL regularization is an ordinary consistency loss, not a real Deutsch CTC fixed point; no actual entangled quantum channel.

historical_evaluation.data: 1,412 JSON-addition events; train 972, validation 196, holdout 196; both variants same classes/splits/denoise masks
legitimate_conclusions: Masked-label accuracy improved by 33.7931 percentage points, but reconstructed-label cross-entropy worsened from 1.71159 to 1.790059.
Next JSON top-1 accuracy improved by 11.2245 percentage points but remains below the class-frequency baseline.
Next JSON log-loss improved by 0.004826 versus V1 and Brier by 0.012122; sample size 196 and heavily OTHER-skewed, significance or durability not established.
JDTC two-phase overall gate fails because phase-one cross-entropy worsened. Production promotion refused.
